anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Plymouth Hotel: Vintage Caravan Bar & Safari Cottages in Addo Elephant National Park
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Experience the unique charm of The Plymouth Hotel, nestled within the tranquil Matyholweni section of Addo Elephant National Park. Our comfortable safari cottages offer a peaceful retreat amidst nature, while our iconic 1969 Shasta Caravan Bar provides a vibrant social hub for evening cocktails and engaging conversations. Perfect for nature enthusiasts and couples, we blend authentic safari adventure with a distinctive vintage flair. Discover genuine hospitality, local tales around the campfire, and easy access to incredible wildlife sightings, making your stay an unforgettable escape into the heart of the Eastern Cape.
